description: This file contains unit tests for the WakeWords utility class/functionality, testing parsing and sanitization of wake word strings.

classes.name: WakeWordsTest
classes.description: Test suite for WakeWords parsing and sanitization functions.

methods.name: parseCommaSeparatedTrimsAndDropsEmpty

methods.name: sanitizeLimitsWordCount
methods.description: Ensures wake words list respects maximum word count limit.
